description: This file defines a React functional component named `VectorStoreForm` which renders a form for creating or managing vector stores in a UI. It includes form fields for provider selection, vector store details, provider-specific inputs, and handles fetching models, form submission, and validation.

classes.name: VectorStoreForm
classes.description: A React functional component providing a form UI to add and manage vector store configurations, integrating provider-specific fields, model selection, JSON metadata, and handling form submission.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the form submission, constructs the payload with provider-specific parameters, validates JSON metadata, calls the API to create the vector store, and manages success/error notifications.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form fields and internal state, then cancels the modal dialog for vector store creation.
